description: This file declares the SessionServerApp class, which implements the ISessionServerApp interface for managing session server applications within the Rialto server manager. It includes class members, constructors, destructors, and methods related to launching, configuring, and controlling session server instances, as well as internal utility functions and synchronization primitives.

classes.name: SessionServerApp
classes.description: A class managing the lifecycle and configuration of a session server application, including socket setup, process management, and timing control within the Rialto server manager.

methods.name: SessionServerApp
methods.description: Constructor initializing the session server application with manager reference, environment variables, server path, timeout, and socket permissions.

methods.name: SessionServerApp
methods.description: Overloaded constructor initializing the session server with application name, initial state, app configuration, manager reference, environment variables, server path, timeout, and socket permissions.

methods.name: ~SessionServerApp
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up resources associated with the session server application.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Starts the session server process.

methods.name: isPreloaded
methods.description: Checks if the session server is preloaded.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the session server with application name, initial state, and app configuration.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the session server is connected.

methods.name: getSessionManagementSocketName
methods.description: Returns the name of the session management socket.

methods.name: getSessionManagementSocketPermissions
methods.description: Returns the permissions of the session management socket.

methods.name: getInitialState
methods.description: Returns the initial state of the session server.

methods.name: getServerId
methods.description: Returns the server ID.

methods.name: getAppName
methods.description: Returns the application name.

methods.name: getAppManagementSocketName
methods.description: Returns the application management socket name.

methods.name: getClientDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the client display name.

methods.name: getMaxPlaybackSessions
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of playback sessions.

methods.name: getMaxWebAudioPlayers
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of Web Audio players.

methods.name: cancelStartupTimer
methods.description: Cancels the startup timer.

methods.name: kill
methods.description: Kills the session server process.

methods.name: initializeSockets
methods.description: Initializes communication sockets for the session server.

methods.name: setupStartupTimer
methods.description: Sets up a timer to monitor startup timeout.

methods.name: spawnSessionServer
methods.description: Spawns the session server process.

methods.name: waitForChildProcess
methods.description: Waits for the child process to terminate.

methods.name: cancelStartupTimerInternal
methods.description: Internal method to cancel the startup timer without virtual dispatch.

methods.name: addAppSuffixToLogFile
methods.description: Adds application suffix to log file environment variable.
